content.title: General Mills Stock Rises on Earnings. Investors Get Signs of Progress.
content.summary: General Mills  stock gained on Wednesday after the packaged-food company reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings.  For its fiscal second quarter ended in November,  General Mills  posted adjusted earnings of $1.10 a share, down 21% from a year ago but ahead of analysts’ consensus of $1.03.  Net sales fell 7% from the prior year to $4.9 billion, but topped Wall Street’s estimate of $4.78 billion.
